name: @polaris/processor-traits-v1
description: Polaris traits runner v1. Evaluates the definitions in catalog/traits/ against the sanctioned ClickHouse projections, diffs each computed value against the profile's current traits, and writes only what changed — bumping traits_version and emitting trait.computed / profile.updated on profile.events. No long-lived service: `polaris traits compute` is the entrypoint. Its description was sessionizer v2's, verbatim, until 2026-08-19.
